verdict.rationale: A government business-registry service could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary for a machine channel, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows only human-facing online filing, search, downloadable forms, live chat and in-person services, plus a probe of a JavaScript app shell. Nothing in it documents any published machine-readable specification.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
